description: This source file defines the AnalyticsClient class which provides async methods to interact with an internal analytics service API. It includes methods for analyzing data, retrieving benchmarks, and computing anomalies, using httpx for HTTP requests and FastAPI exceptions for error handling.

classes.name: AnalyticsClient
classes.description: A client class for communicating with the internal analytics service API using HTTP requests.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the AnalyticsClient with an asynchronous HTTP client with a timeout.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Asynchronously closes the underlying HTTP client.

methods.name: str _base(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the analytics service from configuration or raises an exception if not set.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] analyze(self, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a payload to the analyze endpoint of the analytics service for processing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] benchmark(self, params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Requests benchmark data for a meter against tenant peers from the analytics service.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] anomalies(self, params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Calculates anomaly scores from database readings via the analytics service.
